verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an admin plugin for defining/managing user roles and an organization plugin for member/team permissions, plus a JWT plugin that issues tokens for authorization checks — but no evidence explicitly shows roles/permissions being embedded as claims inside session/JWT tokens or enforced via token-based middleware. missing for 10: explicit docs showing role/permission claims inside issued JWT/session tokens, granular custom-permission definition API, and independent verification that RBAC checks are enforced via token payloads rather than DB lookups.
